name: Invoice total
author: friday-core
description: Totals an invoice from lines such as Laptop 2 x 45000 18% (description, quantity x rate, GST percent, optional discount percent). Returns line totals, taxable value, GST grouped by rate with the CGST and SGST or IGST split, round-off to the nearest rupee and the grand total in words. Rates are taken from each line; check them against the HSN or SAC code before issuing.
